promptingStudio.scene: A local investigative journalism studio. Sharp modern mic presence with close capture, zero fluff or artificial gloss, conveying gritty grassroots reality.
promptingStudio.sampleContext: Direct, serious, candid, and slightly cautionary. Conversational American cadence dissecting local crime statistics and regional abandonment.
promptingStudio.speakerTag: Speaker 1 - Regional Crime & Living Analyst (Liam / Roger)
promptingStudio.sampleSpeechBlock: State. And I'm not talking about the sanitized worst neighborhoods lists that just recycle the same two zip codes. I mean the towns where the violent crime rate runs more than six times the national average. Where a beloved beach vacation spot quietly posts a property crime rate north of 5,000 per 100,000 people. Where a town that literally gave America an astronaut now shows up near the top of the state's crime charts. And where an entire county lives with a poverty rate close to 1 in three. Every number in this video comes from real data. FBI sourced crime reporting compiled by sites like Area Vibes and Neighborhood Scout, Census
